create_BertRandomMaskingScheme: create a BertRandomMaskingScheme instance to mask tokens for masked language model training with 80% mask and 10% random replacement
create_PairWithSpanMaskingScheme: create a PairWithSpanMaskingScheme instance to mask contiguous word-aligned spans using geometric length distribution
create_NERSpanMaskingScheme: create a NERSpanMaskingScheme instance to mask entity spans with configurable probability of entity vs random span masking
run_bert_masking: run bert_masking on a sentence tensor to produce masked sentence, target indices, and None pair targets
run_span_masking: run span_masking on a sentence with span intervals to produce masked sentence, target indices, and padded pair targets
